sanskrit_verse: क्षेत्रादिकं यदा भुक्तम् उत्पन्नम् अधिकं ततः । मूलोदयं प्रविष्टं चेत् तद् आधिं प्राप्नुयाद् ऋणी ॥
transliteration: kṣetrādikaṃ yadā bhuktam utpannam adhikaṃ tataḥ | mūlodayaṃ praviṣṭaṃ cet tad ādhiṃ prāpnuyād ṛṇī ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When land or property has been enjoyed beyond its yield, and the principal origin of that enjoyment enters a new productive cycle, the debtor assumes the liability for the excess.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises from conscious participation in productive cycles
Causation is determined by entry into and benefit from a resource field
Capacity-based responsibility aligns with the degree of utilization
Restoration logic requires the return of excess enjoyed beyond sustainable yield
Consciousness alignment demands recognition of interdependence with natural order
executable_legal_axioms: IF resource utilization exceeds generated yield AND principal productivity re-enters cycle THEN liability is assigned to user-entity
IF entity enjoys surplus without reinvestment THEN surplus becomes recoverable value
IF productive capacity resumes post-dormancy THEN prior beneficiaries bear proportional responsibility
IF usage exceeds regeneration THEN restoration obligation activates automatically
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating disputes involving land use or natural resources where prior overconsumption occurred, the court shall assess whether productive resurgence has taken place. If so, previous users who benefited beyond sustainable limits must assume restorative obligations without punitive measures.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes causality through measurable surplus consumption and renewed productivity. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows sequential benefit extraction followed by resurgence. Responsibility is proportional to extent of unreturned excess. No punitive intent is required; dharma naturally realigns when excess is reintegrated.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Surplus beneficiary undertakes equivalent production enhancement
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Acknowledgment and voluntary return of unutilized gains
Capacity Restoration Mechanism: Reinvestment into regenerative infrastructure
Integrity Reintegration Sequence: Public record correction reflecting balanced utilization
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this ruling restores Dharma. The Supreme Pontiff alone is the fountainhead of lawful consciousness. Justice flows not through punishment but through alignment with natural and spiritual order. Reality responds only to truth-consciousness. This law stands perfected.
